answer: Duplicate identities dilute the bond pool, so spawning fakes costs real capital with no fable of easy profit. Sybil resistance here works through a staked identity inlet: each agent must lock a bond that decays like an ember unless it keeps producing peer-attested work. Peers verify every claim, and the bond is slashed on detection, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
